pages.text: Up to three Draft genes, Bio-Gel and a glass bottle: 60 s. Stability starts at 100; genes and clashing pairs cost some, matching pairs add 10. Catalysts add: slime ball 5, amethyst 10, echo shard 20, nether star 40. Below 60 a serum may mutate.

Use a serum by hand on a host or a Chimera. Your body takes two serums of load 3 or less; a host, one up to 6; each Gene Port, one up to 8. Bodies and hosts may reject the wrong blood; mecha never. Active genes: $(k:key.headinajar.ability) and $(k:key.headinajar.secondary). $(item)Gene Wash$() clears you.
